method: O0/O2 direct GNU Fortran runtime measurement with per-run process-evaluation counters and payload sizes from allocated array extents; production physics and solver tolerances unchanged
scope: same-node-count serialized BASE inactive-option replay versus admitted PPA-WU04A Black runtime profile; external common parameter/state/forcing arrays, runtime common solver/work arrays, Black input payload, and exact Black process-call count

workload.base: three-column serialized A-B-A batch with BASE state/parameter/forcing layouts; Black, Boesten, snow and restricted soil-temperature allocatable payloads are asserted absent
workload.black: admitted WU04A Black production-application profile plus one direct full/half backend trial used to inspect exact option evaluation-call count

measured_payload_bytes.accounting_note: Byte totals use element storage_size multiplied by actual allocated array extents, plus existing Richards and A23BU workspace payload counters. They exclude Fortran allocation descriptors, allocator metadata/alignment, fixed backend record storage, automatic stack temporaries and transient high-water buffers cleared before observation.

additional_checks: BASE optional parameter, forcing and physical-state payloads are absent
BASE option-specific process-call counters remain zero across all three columns
BASE and Black common parameter/state/forcing payloads and serialized common workspace bytes match
Black evaluated exactly three times for the direct full/half trial
the WU04A production application retains its existing hard-mass, retry, restart and layout-guard gates

remaining_gap: Runtime active/inactive measurement covers BASE versus Black only. Runtime option calls and payloads for snow, restricted soil temperature and drainage response, other optional-state compositions, fixed descriptors, allocator overhead and transient peak memory are not measured by this checkpoint.
next_action: Extend the same counters and payload census to admitted active snow, restricted soil-temperature and drainage-response cases where their qualification prerequisites permit; do not treat zero counters in inactive profiles as qualification of the active option.
